description: This file is a header (.h) file for a hardware PHY driver related to Realtek RTL826X series, defining interfaces for read/write operations on PHY registers and including licensing and include guards.

methods.name: rtk_phylib_826xb_sds_read
methods.description: Reads data from a specific PHY register page and register, considering MSB and LSB, into a provided data pointer.

methods.name: rtk_phylib_826xb_sds_write
methods.description: Writes data to a specific PHY register page and register, considering MSB and LSB.
